cohort: 7925 women with histopathologic adenomyosis compared with 4,615,803 women without registered adenomyosis from the Dutch national databases (Perined and the nationwide pathology databank) from 1995 to 2018
finding: Women with a histopathologic diagnosis of adenomyosis had an increased prevalence of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, small-for-gestational-age infants, failure to progress in labor, and placental retention compared with the general population in previous pregnancies.
mod_finding: Women with adenomyosis had a higher prevalence of emergency cesarean delivery and failure to progress in labor compared to the general population.
